description: Save one pick from a list you can read, yours or anyone's, to Library under Saved picks. Use the item id from get_list_items or list_items. Does not copy the pick, follow or publish. Idempotent across retries.

itemId.description: Item id from get_list_items, list_items or search_items.

list.description: Optional list id, slug or handle/slug the pick came from; rejected if the pick is on a different list.

name: save_item
title: Save a pick
